body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Ezex exhibited a 4-inch PIP navigation system ''NAVZEN'' at KES 2006. This navigation system is equipped with an automatic volume control in response to speed change, providing clear PA and broadcasting in an increasingly noisy environment from high speeds. It has an AV-IN terminal connected to a rear-vision camera and an in-car DVD. In addition, it comes with SiRF III chipset and supports audio video files, an MP3 play back and an electronic photo album. Its operating system is Windows CE 4.2.
